name: Party hat
summary: Striped paper cone party hat with a pompom on top and an elastic band; anim pop or wobble.

params.name: y
params.note: y of the open rim (bottom of the hat); the hat rises about 450 px above it

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the hat is about 300 px wide and 470 px tall; use about 0.3 on a head

params.name: anim
params.note: pop = scales in with overshoot; wobble = small tilt back and forth

author: krakujs
